_comment: Behaviour-cloning demonstrations for the final line d7 (rl/gen_bc_tapes.py). Exactly the arguments of the original run: 224 shards (the shard count fixes the train/validation split; any number of processes can run them); shard i takes the worlds whose index in the sorted file list is i mod 224. Sep 30 games (all 2,049 worlds of data/worlds/d0930b), seats of the 10 teams in configs/bc_teams_d7.txt (the leaderboard top 10 on Sep 30) that had >= 4 land quadrants by step 300; games involving our team are skipped.
